assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Coordinate axes with the two blue branches of the hyperbola x^2 - y^2 = 2000^2 and its dashed asymptotes y = x and y = -x. Six lattice points are marked: the vertices at x = 2000 and x = -2000 and the points (2500, 1500), (2500, -1500) and their mirror images on the left branch.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
